purpose: Initial source-screening inventory and implementation test data; NOT a legal rules engine.
interpretation_rules: Not determined is not an assertion that a service is prohibited.
A licensing category's existence does not establish its application to Venfour.
Absence of a licensing program does not establish permission.
A source URL or access date is not legal clearance or proof of current completeness.
Research review priority is operational triage, not a comparative legal-risk score.
Do not promote these records into executable permissions.
No case-specific numeric valuation, tax or deadline rules are approved by this file.
